title: Restore always-visible Add Availability button in day detail view

requirements.summary: Add an always-visible “Add Availability” button above the availability list within the day detail content area.
acceptanceCriteria: When navigating to a day detail view from the calendar, an “Add Availability” button is visible without requiring any additional interactions.
The “Add Availability” button is displayed above the list of users’ availability entries within the day detail UI.
The button label is exactly “Add Availability” (English user-facing text).

file_operations.description: Restore an always-visible primary action inside the day detail CardContent: render a Link-wrapped Button labeled exactly “Add Availability” positioned above the availability list (and above the empty-state content when applicable), without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui.

requirements.summary: Wire the day detail “Add Availability” button to navigate to the existing add/edit availability screen for the selected day via a date search parameter.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the day detail “Add Availability” button navigates to “/add-availability” and includes the selected day as a search parameter (e.g., search.date).
On the Add/Edit Availability page, the displayed date matches the day the user clicked from the calendar.
No backend/canister changes are required for this navigation behavior.

file_operations.description: Ensure the restored “Add Availability” button uses TanStack Router Link to "/add-availability" and passes the selected day detail param as the search parameter (search: { date }).

Ensure the Add/Edit Availability page reliably initializes (and, if needed, re-syncs) its selectedDate from the incoming search.date so the header/date display matches the day clicked from the calendar/day detail, without any backend changes.

requirements.summary: Display the day detail “Add Availability” button even when there are zero availability entries (empty state).
acceptanceCriteria: If a day has zero availability entries, the day detail screen still displays the “Add Availability” button above the empty-state message.
The empty-state message remains visible and readable, and the button remains clearly discoverable above it.

file_operations.description: Update the empty-state branch to render the same “Add Availability” Link/Button inside the day detail CardContent above the empty-state message, keeping the message readable and not removing existing layout structure.
